title: Roster team
description: The referent for control.owner. Today an owner slug points at nothing — 'owner: ml-platform' is a string that validates whether or not such a team exists. This file makes the slug resolvable, so an owner that has been reorganised out of existence becomes a build failure instead of a control nobody notices is orphaned.

team_id.description: Matches the control.owner slug exactly. Stable — renaming a team is a migration across every control that names it, not an edit here.

lead_person_id.description: person_id of the team lead, or null where genuinely unknown. Null is honest; a guessed name is not.

dissolved_on.description: Set when a team stops existing. Controls still owned by a dissolved team are orphaned — that is the finding.
